correctness.rationale: Under r>m>0, phi>=0, finite N>=2, identical independent local-reset clocks, first-Wasserstein contraction of synchronized copies proves unique finite-first-moment invariant. Generator yields the correct two-dimensional Metzler raw moment matrix K; Perron eigenvalue gives finite second moments iff m < (3r+2phi -sqrt((r-2phi)^2+8r phi/N))/4, including equality divergence. Independent symbolic rational algebra confirms det K=2D, centered V=Q(delta+phi/N)/D and C=Q phi/(ND), derivatives, critical m=r/2 locking C=x0^2/(N-1), and square-root finite-size window. No stronger tail law claimed.
